title: NR-RRC: Add callable dissectors for SIB messages
description:
Add callable dissectors for SIB messages.
Add dis table
Fix column display for single SIB message.

notes.body: This will not display nicely if multiple SIBs are included in the same system information message. What was wrong with the previous display?
If we have a single sib it will look wierd. Add a space after sib?
As far as I can remember (I do not have access to the code right now) a single SIB should look like [ SIB1 ] and two SIBs [ SIB1 SIB2 ]
Only sib no system information message mind you.

Yes we could add the space after the SIB instead of before, or keep in the pinfo context whether this is the first SIB or not in a system information to have [SIB1] and [SIB1,SIB2]. By the time I wrote it I wanted to keep it simple did not think about a SIB decoding outside of a system information.
